name: blurkeep
description: Blur background notes when editing in Google Keep for distraction-free focus

scripts.dev: web-ext run --source-dir=. --target=firefox-desktop --ignore-files generate_assets.py screenshot.jpg icon-128.jpg README.md package.json package-lock.json scripts scripts/** .github .github/**
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files generate_assets.py screenshot.jpg icon-128.jpg README.md package.json package-lock.json scripts scripts/** .github .github/**
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --overwrite-dest --ignore-files generate_assets.py screenshot.jpg icon-128.jpg README.md package.json package-lock.json scripts scripts/** .github .github/**
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --channel=listed --approval-timeout=0 --ignore-files generate_assets.py screenshot.jpg icon-128.jpg README.md package.json package-lock.json scripts scripts/** .github .github/** --amo-metadata=scripts/amo-metadata.json --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"
scripts.sign:self: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --channel=unlisted --ignore-files generate_assets.py screenshot.jpg icon-128.jpg README.md package.json package-lock.json scripts scripts/** .github .github/** --amo-metadata=scripts/amo-metadata.json --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"
